prompt_md: A raindrop lands at a uniformly random spot on a 10 m by 10 m square patio. On average, how far is it from the nearest edge, in meters?
prompt_short: Random spot on a 10 m square. Average distance to the nearest edge?
hint_md: Most of the area is close to the edges.
explain_intuition_md: Halfway to the center (2.5 m) would be right if spots were spread evenly by distance, but area is not. A band along the edges holds far more area than a band of the same width near the center, so drops crowd toward the edges. The average works out to just 5/3 m.
